description:
Hi, I’m Amos Fisher.

I was raised around people who believed a good life should be simple, useful, and built to last. We grew our own food, repaired what was broken, made do with what we had, and learned practical skills from the generations before us.

The Amos Fisher Way is about bringing those old lessons back into modern life.

Here you’ll find traditional Amish wisdom, forgotten household methods, homestead skills, gardening and food preservation, natural pest control, simple building projects, land knowledge, and practical ways to waste less and depend less on expensive systems.

Nothing here is fancy.

Just ordinary materials, careful hands, patience, and common sense.

New videos uploaded regularly.

Subscribe and discover a simpler way of doing things - The Amos Fisher Way.
